activity_summary: You stood in the south aisle for the long gospel. The parish was in black. Master Thwaite did not hurry it, and he looked at nobody. A quarter was gone and he was not yet at the cross. You wrote nothing. You left the morning's question at home. There was no bread and no cup.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Stood, wrote nothing, and left the question at home.

entities.name: Master Josias Thwaite
entities.context: Read the long gospel, refused haste, and looked at nobody.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Kept the aisle from being trimmed, and kept it from becoming a report.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Said the ledge was bare, and that there was no bread and no cup.

facets.activity: Stood for the long gospel in black

quotes.speaker: josias_thwaite
quotes.text: The gospel this morning is the long one.

quotes.speaker: alse_pinder
quotes.text: There is no bread on the ledge, and no cup.
